verdict.rationale: Airwallex is a payments platform, so ML fraud screening and custom block/review/allow rules are a fair axis to judge. The pack documents no fraud scores and no rule engine. The only nearby items are a passing mention of 'risk' simulation docs in the sandbox and dispute-management facilitation, which are adjacent and do not show the capability.

support.subject: As a finance-ops user, I can screen transactions with machine-learning fraud scores and write custom block, review, and allow rules
